name: zcom_m01_helpers
description: zCom connection-point helper wrappers query IConnectionPointContainer, find a requested connection point, dispatch Advise or Unadvise, and release transient provider interfaces.
tier_s_evidence: python tools/recoil.py verify vc5 zcom_m01_helpers passed for 0x42dc30 and 0x42dcf0 with VC5SP3 compiler 11.00.7022, profile vc5_o2_ob1_md_gx_facs, source src/GameZRecoil/zCom/zCom.cpp, and zero unmasked COFF relocation-masked byte mismatches for zCom::ConnectionPointContainer_Advise and zCom::ConnectionPointContainer_Unadvise.
